BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the prevention of animal cruelty; adding a newsection to chapter 16.52 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 16.52 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as authorized in subsection (4) of this section, noperson shall sell, offer for sale, barter, or auction an animal uponany public property or upon private property open to the public. (2) For purposes of this section, public property consists of anystate or countyowned real property or other interest in real estate,including but not limited to parks, playgrounds, and other publicrecreation areas, as well as streets, roads, alleys, and other publicrightofways. (3) For the purposes of this section, private property open to thepublic includes but is not limited to any commercial or retail parkinglot, sidewalk, or empty lot, and any flea market or swap meet. (4) This section does not apply to the sale, offer for sale,barter, or auction of an animal that occurs: (a) On private property not open to the public; p. 1 HB 1201 (b) At a legally permitted pet shop, kennel, or other commercialbusiness legally permitted to sell animals where the owner or operatorof the pet shop, kennel, or other commercial business sells, offers forsale, barters, or auctions the animal; (c) At or through any local government animal care and controlagency, nonprofit humane society, and other nonprofit organizationdedicated to the humane care and adoption of abused, neglected, orunwanted animals; (d) At or through any other organization dedicated to the humanecare and adoption of abused, neglected, or unwanted animals that isregistered as a charity with the secretary of state, is workingcooperatively with an organization defined in (c) of this subsection,or is approved by the local jurisdiction in which the sale or transferoccurs; (e) At public livestock markets licensed under chapter 16.65 RCW; (f) At farmers' cooperative association or livestock breeders'association events permitted under chapter 16.65 RCW; (g) At events permitted under chapter 16.65 RCW and managed byyouth livestock organizations, such as 4H, future farmers of America,or other junior livestock group; (h) At area fairs, county and district fairs, community fairs, andyouth shows and fairs as defined in RCW 15.76.120; and (i) At competitive cat or dog shows, horse shows, bird shows,reptile and amphibian expositions, or other legally permitted animalexpositions or shows, provided that the person offering the animal forsale or transfer is a paid entrant to the show and any sale or transferof the animal occurs on the premises of the show. (5)(a) A person who violates this section for the first time hascommitted a class 2 civil infraction under RCW 7.80.120(1)(b). (b) A person who violates this section for a second or subsequenttime is guilty of a misdemeanor.
